descriptions.job-1kiiwj3:
Build a Safer World.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

TRM helps financial institutions detect and stop illicit finance, and this role brings that mission to private sector clients including banks, payment providers, crypto natives and fintechs across DACH. You will own the Private Sector business in a territory where TRM is building coverage, setting account strategy and strategic deals with compliance and risk leaders. What makes this seat unusual is a base of existing DACH customers to grow, plus real room to build new accounts and the freedom to shape your own go-to-market with local partners and AI-assisted research.

The impact you will have:

  • Open new private sector accounts across the DACH region. Working with internal and external stakeholders to build effective networks to deliver commercial execution of TRM’s services to leading private sector organisations across the region.

  • Win a mixture of high velocity and larger more strategic engagements, by turning AML and fraud pain points into a clear business case, with AI-drafted account plans and proposals that you sharpen with your own market judgment.

  • Own and define the model to build a 3x qualified pipeline each quarter through targeted campaigns, using AI-assisted segmentation and local-language messaging, and measure what converts.

  • Decide how TRM enters each market, choosing between direct selling, resellers, and regional partners, and back each choice with AI-assisted analysis of account data.

  • Grow strategic existing customers engagements through renewals, upsells, and new use cases.

  • Bring customer and regulatory insight back to Product and Marketing so the next release matches how banks in your region actually work.

What we’re looking for:

  • 5+ years selling SaaS or data products into banks, payment firms, crypto or fintechs in DACH, or 4+ years with deep AML and financial crime expertise, plus experience using AI tools to research and prioritize accounts.

  • A record of closing a mixture of quick deal cycle and strategic longer term, higher value engagements and meeting quota, with AI-supported forecasting and pipeline reviews.

  • Working knowledge of regional AML and sanctions frameworks and how compliance, risk, and procurement teams buy.

  • Hands-on use of AI for prospecting, account planning, and call preparation, with clear examples of time or revenue gained.

  • Experience building pipeline in a new territory, forming human lead networks and AI-assisted tools to test and measure what works.

  • Credible, clear communication with senior compliance and risk executives, in person and virtually, including AI-assisted preparation for each meeting.

  • Fluent German and English, French and additional relevant languages a bonus

  • Based in Germany and willingness to travel regularly across the region.

About the Team:

  • TRM’s EMEA Sales team gives each Account Director full ownership of a territory and the room to choose how to win it.

  • The team collaborates closely and supports one another through shared pipeline insight, deal reviews, and open sharing of what works.

  • The work is hard in a useful way: regulated buyers, several countries, long procurement cycles, and a product category that is still new to many banks.

  • You will work with RevOps, Marketing, Legal, Product, and Solutions Architecture, who move quickly to back your deals.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • Within your first 30 days, you rank every target bank and fintech in your territory and start outreach to the top tier, so pipeline grows before onboarding ends.

  • When a compliance leader asks for a demo late on a Friday, you and TRM’s Solutions team deliver it that day, turning a warm inquiry into a scheduled evaluation by Monday.

  • Within 90 days, you build qualified pipeline worth at least 3x your quota, backed by an account plan for every Tier 1 target.

Team Operating Rhythms:

  • Distributed, not distant: the team works across UK and CET time zones, and occasional US calls on complex deals.

  • Slack is the center of day-to-day communication. @mention colleagues for timely responses.

  • Weekly 1:1 with your manager, a weekly team call, a weekly pipeline call, a weekly forecast call, and regular pod calls.

  • Company-wide all-hands and founder Q&A sessions keep everyone connected to the mission.

Required online and collaboration hours:

  • Schedule: Core hours overlapping CET, with flexibility for occasional US calls.

Application Instructions

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.

Interviewing with TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

  • Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

  • Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

  • First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

  • Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

  • References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

  • Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

  • Welcome to TRM: We're excited to build a safer world with you!

Your recruiter will share your specific interview plan and preparation guidance along the way.

AI Fluency at TRM

AI fluency is a baseline expectation at TRM.

We believe AI meaningfully changes how top performers operate. We expect every team member to use AI to accelerate and reimagine their craft, not just automate surface tasks.

At TRM, AI fluency means you are among the top 10 percent of operators in your function in how you apply AI to:

  • Accelerate repeatable workflows

  • Structure and solve problems

  • Improve output quality

  • Increase speed and leverage

You will be evaluated on applied AI fluency during the interview process.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves FAST. We are a high-velocity, high-ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly. The pace and intensity of the work reflect the importance of the mission. As a result, the way we operate requires a high level of ownership, adaptability, collaboration, and creative problem-solving.

At TRM, you should expect:

  • Priorities and targets to change quickly

  • Operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • A high level of personal ownership and accountability

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

This environment is energizing for people who enjoy building, solving hard problems, and making progress in situations that are not always fully defined. It also requires thriving in ambiguity, adjusting course as new information emerges, and maintaining focus and positivity in a fast-moving and intense environment.

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. If you are primarily optimizing for predictability or a consistently balanced workload, we encourage you to use the interview process to pressure-test whether this environment is truly the right fit. We want teammates who thrive here, not just survive here.

If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute.

Leadership Principles

We hire and grow against three leadership principles. They’re the standards for how we operate, treat each other, and make decisions.

  • Impact-Oriented Trailblazer: We put customers first and move with speed, focus, and adaptability. We treat every plan like an experiment – test, ship, measure, and iterate quickly.

  • Master Craftsperson: We care deeply about our craft. We balance speed with high standards, own outcomes end‑to‑end, and invest in getting better everyday.

  • Inspiring Colleague: We add clarity and energy, not noise. We bring humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset — giving and receiving feedback to make the team stronger.

Join our Mission

At TRM, we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

TRM is a Series C company with $220M in total funding, backed by Goldman Sachs, Bessemer, Y Combinator, Thoma Bravo, and others. Headquartered in San Francisco, TRM operates as a distributed-first company with hubs in Los Angeles, San Francisco, New York, Washington D.C., London, and Singapore.

Privacy Policy and Additional Information

By submitting your application, you agree to allow TRM Labs to process your personal information in accordance with our Privacy Policy.

We collect the information you provide (such as your resume, work history, and contact details) solely for the purpose of evaluating your candidacy for current and future roles at TRM.

Because our hiring cycles for certain positions may span 24 to 36 months, we retain your personal information for up to 36 months from the date of your application. After that period, your data is deleted unless a different retention period is required or permitted by law.

If you are located in the European Economic Area, the United Kingdom, or another jurisdiction with applicable data protection laws, you have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your personal data at any time before that period ends. To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trmlabs.com.

To notify TRM Labs that you believe this job posting is non-compliant, please submit a report through this form. No response will be provided to inquiries unrelated to job posting compliance.

The use of AI tools of any kind (including but not limited to notetakers, interview assistants, and real-time coaching tools such as Otter.ai, Fireflies, Fathom, Cluey, or similar) during TRM interviews is not permitted without prior approval from TRM. TRM uses its own internal tools for note-taking to ensure a consistent and confidential experience for all candidates.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities, and requests can be made via this form.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company without a signed agreement.
descriptions.job-0nz7e27:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

Brokerage sits at the heart of Robinhood, powering how millions of customers invest and interact with financial products. The Brokerage Technical Program Management team is small and collaborative, and it works side by side with senior engineers, engineering managers, product leaders, and Brokerage leadership on complex technical and execution challenges. We partner closely with design, customer experience, and operations teams to bring ambitious work to life. The team is still shaping how it plans, executes, launches, and uses AI, so there’s real room to build the playbook rather than inherit one!

As a Technical Program Manager on Brokerage, you’ll own and drive cross-functional engineering programs from kickoff through launch. You’ll keep plans, milestones, risks, and dependencies clear and visible, and you’ll turn complex technical work into crisp updates for leadership and partner teams. The mix of programs will flex with company priorities, and you’ll be trusted with real ownership early on. You’ll also have the chance to rethink traditional TPM workflows with AI, from planning to launch readiness. Expect close mentorship and a clear runway to grow your career here!

This role is based in our New York, NY and Menlo Park, CA offices, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you’ll do

  • Drive execution across multiple cross-functional engineering teams, from kickoff through launch
  • Own program plans, milestones, risks, and dependencies, and keep them visible to stakeholders
  • Coordinate with product, design, customer experience, operations, and engineering partners
  • Write clear narratives, status updates, and communications for leadership and partner teams
  • Spot gaps and unblock work so programs keep moving with minimal oversight
  • Help shape how the Brokerage TPM team plans, executes, and launches, including how it uses AI to improve planning, dependency management, risk detection, launch readiness, and reporting

What you bring

  • 5+ years of experience in technical program management or a similar role, driving complex cross-functional engineering programs
  • Strong grasp of system design, with the ability to follow and contribute to engineering conversations (no coding required)
  • Working familiarity with AWS and core infrastructure concepts
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication, including concise narratives and executive-ready updates that translate complex technical work
  • Strong ownership of outcomes, with the initiative to identify next steps, close gaps, and resolve blockers without waiting to be asked
  • A proven record of running programs with minimal oversight and following through on commitments until problems are resolved
  • Comfort stepping outside a narrowly defined scope when the program needs it
  • Strong organizational skills, with the ability to create structure and clarity across complex, multi-team programs without adding unnecessary process
  • Curiosity and excitement about using AI as part of how you work

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career
  • Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching
  • Top Tier benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents
  • Access to the Robinhood Employee Fund that gives eligible US employees the opportunity to invest in a private employee fund that provides exposure to Robinhood Ventures funds.
  • Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not.
  • Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more
  • Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits
  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more!
  • Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces.

In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits.

Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process.

Base Pay Range:

Zone 1 (Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Bellevue, WA; Washington, DC)
$140,000—$165,000 USD
Zone 2 (Denver, CO; Westlake, TX; Chicago, IL)
$123,000—$145,000 USD
Zone 3 (Lake Mary, FL; Clearwater, FL; Gainesville, FL)
$110,000—$129,000 USD

Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity.

If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application.

AI Usage Disclosure: Robinhood uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruiting process. These tools enhance the efficiency and consistency of our hiring process; however, all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams.

Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. Please review the Privacy Policy for your country of application.
descriptions.job-1t65chb:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

In this role, you'd be joining the Alloy Integrations team. We own how Metronome's customers collect payments and recognize revenue. We build and run the integrations that connect Metronome's usage-based billing platform to the systems businesses depend on to get paid: Stripe invoicing and payments, cloud marketplaces (AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud), ERP systems like NetSuite and QuickBooks, and CRM systems like Salesforce. We also bring Stripe products such as Checkout into Metronome, so customers can move from contract to cash in one place.

Our team helps Stripe increase the GDP of the internet by making sure every invoice reaches the right system and every payment is collected and accounted for correctly, at scale. We focus on two areas:

  • Invoicing: collection, dunning, and invoice delivery
  • Quote-to-cash automation: connecting the full journey from a signed deal to recognized revenue

What you'll do

You'll build and operate distributed systems that move billing data between Metronome and the platforms our customers use to run their finances. The work combines product engineering and reliability. You'll ship features that customers ask for directly, and you'll strengthen the event-driven pipelines that handle large invoicing spikes every month-end.

You'll work closely with our product manager, with partner engineering teams that own contracts, usage rating, and invoice finalization, with solutions architects who build ERP integrations with customers, and with technical support engineers who work with customers every day. In your first few months, you'll ship a customer-facing improvement to one of our integrations, join the on-call rotation, and take ownership of one of our core systems.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain integrations between Metronome and external billing, payments, marketplace, ERP, and CRM platforms
  • Build reliable, event-driven systems for invoice delivery, payment workflows, and status sync, with safe retries, rollbacks, and reconciliation
  • Ship features that help customers control how they invoice, collect, and account for revenue, from design through launch
  • Improve observability and automated repair across our systems so problems are caught and fixed before customers notice them
  • Participate in an on-call rotation and lead incident response, root-cause analysis, and follow-up work for the systems the team owns
  • Plan and carry out migrations and changes to existing integrations without disrupting customer billing
  • Partner with product, support, solutions architecture, and other engineering teams to scope work and represent customer needs

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • This is a Staff level role, so we typically target 10+ years of professional experience building and operating backend systems in production
  • Experience designing and integrating with third-party APIs, including handling failures, retries, and data consistency across systems
  • Experience with distributed or event-driven systems, such as message queues, streams, or workflow engines
  • Experience owning services in production, including monitoring, on-call, and incident response
  • Ability to communicate technical tradeoffs clearly to engineers and to people outside engineering

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience with billing, invoicing, payments, tax, or other financial systems where correctness matters
  • Experience with AWS serverless and data services such as Lambda, Kinesis, SQS, or Step Functions
  • Familiarity with ERP or CRM platforms such as NetSuite, QuickBooks, or Salesforce, or with cloud marketplace billing
  • Experience with GraphQL APIs and relational databases such as Postgres
  • Experience leading cross-team projects or large migrations
descriptions.job-0j2jrov:
COMPANY

At 0x, our mission is to "Create a Tokenized World Where All Forms of Value Can Flow Freely". We deliver this to web3 builders with a delightfully simple suite of developer APIs that provide faster trading, better prices, and superior user experience.

Founded in 2017, we’ve processed over 211M+ transactions and $180B+ in trading volume from users trading on Matcha, Coinbase Wallet, Robinhood Wallet, Phantom, Rainbow, DefiLlama, MetaMask, Zerion, Zapper, and many more. Our investors include Greylock Partners, Pantera Capital, and Jump Crypto.

When you join 0x, you’ll become part of a veteran team of crypto builders who know the importance of code quality, team cohesion, and a culture of learning.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Brand Designer to help elevate the visual identity of two very different brands across every touchpoint: 0x, our onchain routing infrastructure, and Matcha, our consumer DEX aggregator. Today, the biggest priorities are sales enablement, web design and social graphics, with about 90% of your time spent on 0x and 10% on Matcha.

This is a senior, hands-on role for a designer who can move fluidly between high-craft visual design and the practical demands of a fast-moving marketing and sales function. As the only designer on our marketing team, you’ll play a key part in shaping how the 0x and Matcha brands look and feel.

The role requires an overlap with US Pacific hours.

What you’ll do

  • Evolve visual identity and brand guidelines for 0x.

  • Design and maintain a library of sales enablement assets: pitch decks, one-pagers, case studies, proposal templates and partner kits.

  • Design web pages, including landing pages, product pages, and comparison pages.

  • Design social graphics for both 0x and Matcha.

  • Design for campaign launches and major sales or industry moments, from concept through final assets.

  • Build brand and marketing templates and components that non-designers can use confidently across campaigns, social and sales materials.

  • Stay current on crypto, DeFi and fintech design trends.

What you’ll bring

  • 4+ years of brand design experience, including at least 1 year in crypto, DeFi or emerging tech.

  • A portfolio of shipped brand work across web, social and sales materials.

  • A track record of shaping and extending a visual identity, not just working within one.

  • Strong typography and layout skills.

  • Expert-level Figma skills, including building reusable templates and components.

  • Fluency with AI design tools, and experience using them to raise both the speed and quality of your work.

  • Experience partnering closely with marketing and sales teams, translating business goals into design.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present and defend design decisions.

  • A bias for action: you get things done without waiting to be asked and adapt quickly as priorities shift.

  • Alignment with our core values: do the right thing, consistently ship, and focus on long-term impact.

  • Ability to attend annual in-person team offsites around the globe.


Nice to have

  • Experience building pages in Webflow, plus basic HTML/CSS.

  • Experience taking a website redesign from concept to launch.

  • Illustration and basic motion design skills.

  • Experience designing for both B2B and B2C audiences.

BENEFITS

  • The base salary range for this position is USD $120,000 - $180,000 + equity + ZRX tokens + benefits. Within the range, individual pay is determined by job-related skills, experience, location, business needs, and candidate preferences between the different compensation elements.

  • Comprehensive insurance (medical/dental/vision/life/disability) for U.S.-based employees — 100% of base plan covered for you and dependents

  • 401k and FSA for U.S.-based employees

  • Monthly mobile phone bill, wellness, and pre-tax transportation expense

  • Covered mental health benefits (included professional therapy sessions)

  • A supportive remote environment

  • Lunch reimbursement for all employees across the globe!

  • Stipend for your ideal remote / WFH set-up: headphones, and any other work gear you may need

  • 12-week paid parental leave

  • Great office conveniently located in the SF Financial District for those in the region!

  • Flexible vacation: Take time when you need it (and we really mean it!)

0x and its associated entities are dedicated to fostering diversity, inclusion, and belonging in its teams and workforce, and are proud to be equal opportunity employers. 0x does not make employment or hiring decisions on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, sex (including those who are pregnant or have given birth), sexual orientation, gender, gender expression or identity, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, citizenship, national origin, immigration or citizenship status, political affiliation, or any other basis that is protected by applicable local, state, or federal laws. This includes not making such decisions based on the status itself, as well as any associations, perceptions, and assumptions made regarding these statuses. 0x will also consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in a way that is consistent with San Francisco’s Fair Chance Ordinance and similar local laws. descriptions.job-0t6n1pr:
Lightspark is creating the Money Grid, modern, open financial infrastructure that makes payments accessible, affordable, and instant for businesses and users worldwide. We're challenging the status quo, updating the current system, and empowering our partners to build better solutions. Together, we're building the most advanced financial infrastructure, open, instant, and global, inspiring a future where anyone, anywhere can access the full potential of digital money.

We are looking for a Risk Manager to lead the risk management function of Lightspark’s Estonian regulated entity, an e-money institution and crypto-asset service provider. The role will be responsible for building out and running a risk framework that keeps pace with a fast-growing business, covering everything from risk appetite and key risk indicators to ICT risk, business continuity and the safeguarding of client funds. You will work closely with the Management Board, the Supervisory Board and teams across the business, giving practical risk guidance that supports sustainable growth with a risk based methodology applied to new business. If you enjoy building structure from the ground up, want real ownership of a second-line function and are interested in stable coins, card payments and embedded finance, this is a good opportunity to make a real difference.

As the Risk Manager, you will report to a member of the Management Board and own the company’s risk management framework end to end. Your work will cover the risk appetite statement and its reporting, risk and control registers, key risk indicators, company-wide risk assessments, fraud risk, ICT and security risk under DORA, business continuity, third-party risk and oversight of finance-related risks such as own funds and safeguarding. You will also lead our risk-related supervisory reporting, prepare the company for supervisory reviews and build risk awareness across the organization. This is a second-line role where independent judgement and the ability to turn regulation into working processes matter equally.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own and develop the risk management policies and procedures, including their annual review and the risk-related processes embedded in other company policies.

  • Map the company’s key risks to first-line owners, define measurable and collectible key risk indicators and set up ongoing risk monitoring.

  • Build and maintain the risk and control register, with a documented annual review cycle.

  • Finalize and run the Risk Appetite Statement, including mapping data sources, populating the reporting form and reporting quarterly to the Management Board and the Supervisory Board for approval.

  • Lead company-wide risk assessments, including for new products, business lines and material changes.

  • Develop card payment fraud risk processes together with Operations, building on the existing fraud risk policy.

  • Lead ICT and security risk management in line with DORA, including the ICT risk register, ICT and information asset registers and the vendor register, and deliver the ICT risk work plan.

  • Own business continuity management, keeping the business impact analysis and business continuity plan current as new business lines, processes and vendors are added, and run incident management walkthroughs and tabletop exercises with the group information security team.

  • Manage ICT third-party risk, including reviewing vendor agreements against DORA requirements and preparing the register of information for supervisory reporting.

  • Lead risk-related supervisory reporting, including operational risk and DORA reporting, and prepare the company for supervisory inspections, including on ICT risk management and crypto-asset custody.

  • Oversee finance-related risks, including periodic own funds calculations and projections, secure and highly automated safeguarding account flows without single-person access, and reporting obligations to stablecoin issuer partners.

  • Prepare clear risk management reports for the Management Board and the Supervisory Board.

  • Build a culture of risk awareness, including running the annual risk training and internal workshops.

  • Work with Compliance, AML, Legal, Operations, Product, Engineering and Finance to build risk management into daily operations.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • 3+ years of experience in risk management at a credit institution, e-money institution, payment institution, investment firm or crypto-asset service provider, or equivalent experience in the financial sector or at a public authority.

  • Ideally, experience in working closely with and/or co-ordinating communication with the Estonian FSA

  • University degree in finance, economics, business, law or a comparable field preferred.

  • Solid knowledge of EU and Estonian risk management regulation and guidelines, including DORA, the relevant EBA guidelines on internal governance, ICT and security risk and outsourcing, and the own funds and safeguarding requirements under EMD and PSD2.

  • Hands-on experience building risk frameworks, such as risk appetite statements, key risk indicators, risk and control registers, business impact analyses and business continuity plans.

  • A good understanding of ICT risk, information security and third-party risk management.

  • Strong project management skills and a structured way of working, with the ability to run several workstreams against regulatory deadlines.

  • A proactive attitude and the independence to operate as a second-line function, proposing initiatives and developing new ideas on your own.

  • Good communication skills, with the ability to present risk matters to the Management Board and Supervisory Board and explain them in practical terms to non-risk audiences.

  • Knowledge of virtual assets and blockchain technology, crypto-asset custody, card payments and fraud, AML/CFT and sanctions, data protection, or embedded finance and banking-as-a-service setups is a plus.

  • Working proficiency in Estonian and English.

  • On-site 5 days, Full time, permanent.

COMPENSATION

The gross monthly base salary range for this role is €4,400 – €5,170. The final offer will depend on experience and skills, and is determined using objective, gender-neutral criteria. You will also be eligible for an annual performance bonus and equity.

Lightspark is on a mission to build the future of open, instant, and global financial infrastructure making payments accessible and affordable for everyone, everywhere. We're committed to creating a more inclusive and diverse workplace to reflect the customers we serve. We welcome interest from individuals of all backgrounds and levels of experience who share our mission. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

 

For US Applicants:

We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the State of California Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring.

For EU Applicants:

In accordance with applicable EU and local regulations, including the Estonian Employment Contracts Act, Equal Treatment Act, and Gender Equality Act, Lightspark ensures equal treatment throughout the hiring process.
descriptions.job-0pey94f:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. descriptions.job-1p0vq3z:
DRW is a diversified trading firm with over 3 decades of experience bringing sophisticated technology and exceptional people together to operate in markets around the world. We value autonomy and the ability to quickly pivot to capture opportunities, so we operate using our own capital and trading at our own risk.

Headquartered in Chicago with offices throughout the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Asia, we trade a variety of asset classes including Fixed Income, ETFs, Equities, FX, Commodities and Energy across all major global markets. We have also leveraged our expertise and technology to expand into three non-traditional strategies: real estate, venture capital and cryptoassets.

We operate with respect, curiosity and open minds. The people who thrive here share our belief that it’s not just what we do that matters–it's how we do it. DRW is a place of high expectations, integrity, innovation and a willingness to challenge consensus.

About the Role

DRW is building out its offensive security capability, and we’re looking for a Senior Offensive Security Engineer to lead the charge. In this role, you’ll plan and execute red team engagements, penetration tests, and adversary simulations against our trading infrastructure, corporate environment, and cloud platforms, acting as a trusted adversary who helps us find and fix weaknesses before anyone else does.

You’ll work closely with our security, infrastructure, and trading teams to translate what you find into real improvements, and you’ll help shape the methodology, tooling, and roadmap for offensive security at DRW as the function matures. This is a hands-on, high-trust role for someone who thinks like an attacker, communicates like a partner, and cares about making the firm measurably harder to compromise.

What You'll Do

  • Plan and execute red team engagements and adversary simulations against trading systems, corporate IT, and cloud environments, modeling realistic attacker tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs) mapped to frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK
  • Conduct penetration tests across networks, web and internal applications, APIs, and cloud infrastructure, and report findings with clear, actionable remediation guidance
  • Design and build custom tooling, scripts, and exploits to emulate adversary behavior, test control effectiveness, and validate detection coverage
  • Partner with the Security Engineering and SOC teams in purple-team exercises to close gaps between what attackers can do and what defenders can see
  • Run social engineering and phishing simulations to assess and improve organizational security awareness
  • Identify, validate, prioritize, and track vulnerabilities and control weaknesses through to remediation in collaboration with infrastructure, platform, and application owners
  • Present engagement results and risk narratives to both technical teams and senior leadership in a way that drives action
  • Stay current on the threat landscape, emerging TTPs, and offensive tooling, and bring that knowledge back into DRW’s defenses
  • Assess the security of AI and LLM-integrated systems, including prompt injection, model manipulation, data poisoning, and abuse of agentic workflows, and work with teams building these systems to harden them
  • Leverage AI-assisted tooling to accelerate reconnaissance, vulnerability discovery, and exploit development, and evaluate new AI-powered offensive techniques as they emerge
  • Help define and mature DRW’s offensive security methodology, standards, and tooling, and mentor other engineers on the security team

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in offensive security, penetration testing, or red teaming, including full engagement lifecycle work: reconnaissance, initial access, privilege escalation, lateral movement, persistence, and exfiltration
  • Strong scripting or programming ability for building and adapting offensive tooling
  • Solid understanding of networking fundamentals, Windows, macOS, and Linux internals, identity providers, and cloud platforms
  • Practical experience with common offensive security tools (e.g., Cobalt Strike, Metasploit, BloodHound, Burp Suite, Nmap) and a track record of building your own when the situation calls for it
  • Working knowledge of the MITRE ATT&CK framework, adversary emulation, and detection evasion techniques, along with enough understanding of defensive controls and tooling to help defenders improve
  • A track record of clear, precise reporting and communication and you can translate technical findings into risk that both engineers and executives understand
  • Experience with smart contract auditing and blockchain security
  • Familiarity with AI/ML security risks, including adversarial attacks on models, prompt injection, and the offensive and defensive implications of LLM-powered tooling
  • A collaborative mindset: you see red teaming as a way to make the whole organization more secure, not just to find flaws

For more information about DRW's processing activities and our use of job applicants' data, please view our Privacy Notice at https://drw.com/privacy-notice.

California residents, please review the California Privacy Notice for information about certain legal rights at https://drw.com/california-privacy-notice.

The Role

Block’s Detection and Response Team (DART) investigates and responds to threats across our products and systems. Within DART, the Computer Security Incident Response Team (CSIRT) leads complex investigations and coordinates the response to security incidents across the company. You’ll establish what happened, determine the scope and impact, guide containment and recovery, and keep responders and stakeholders aligned.

You’ll be a trusted resource for your peers, contributing technical judgment and direction to complex investigations and helping the team make sound decisions. You’ll partner closely with engineers, other security teams, Legal, Privacy, and business leaders. Between incidents, you’ll innovate by building the tools, workflows, and procedures that make our response stronger.

  • Command complex, high-impact security incidents from initial assessment through containment, recovery, and closure.
  • Investigate threats across endpoint, identity, cloud, SaaS, network, and application systems and drive containment and remediation with system owners, weighing urgency, evidence preservation, and business impact.

  • Coordinate containment and remediation with system owners while balancing urgency and business impact.
  • Keep incident priorities, decisions, owners, and handoffs clear across teams and time zones.
  • Lead post-incident reviews and drive findings, uncertainty, and response decisions to technical teams and business partners.
  • Write code, queries, and automation that accelerate evidence collection, analysis, and response. Partner with triage, detection, threat intelligence, and infrastructure teams to address missing telemetry, improve detections, and remove recurring manual work.
